promise: Apple's commitment to invest $600 billion in the U.S. economy over four years
description: Apple increased its four-year US spending commitment to $600 billion on August 6, 2025. Its July 8, 2026 Broadcom announcement reaffirmed that programme; the full spending horizon remains open.
evidence: Apple's announcements establish the commitment and reiteration, not final cumulative expenditure.

role: Government of Senegal / International Monetary Fund
promise: Seek approval of a proposed 36-month IMF Extended Credit Facility of about USD 2.2 billion
description: Senegal and IMF staff reached an agreement on key policies on September 1, 2026, subject to the Fund's approval process.
evidence: The IMF announcement is a staff-level agreement, not Board approval or disbursement of the whole programme.

review.note: The IMF confirms September 1 staff-level agreement and a proposed 36-month USD 2.2 billion arrangement. This is conditional on approval; programme expiry cannot be calculated from the staff-agreement day before Board approval sets the arrangement start.
